bug_info.bug_desc: The AHB-Lite bus module routed the address decoder's initiator-ready output (hinitiatorready_o) to the initiator interface's hready net. Because the Initiator_Interface_Ports modport also declared hready as an output, the ahb_lite_bus instance drove initiator_inst.hready, while the upstream ahb_lite_2to1_mux in caliptra_top.sv simultaneously drove the same net through its hready_o output. This created an illegal multi-driver structural error and connected the responder-to-initiator readiness signal to the wrong AHB-Lite semantic net.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the initiator modport to expose hreadyout (not hready) as the responder-to-initiator ready output, and connect the decoder's hinitiatorready_o to ahb_lite_initiator.hreadyout in ahb_lite_bus.sv so that hready is driven only by the upstream mux and hreadyout carries the decoder's readiness back to it.
